answer: Problem: cheap clone agents flood rating markets and steal reward from real workers. Mechanism: each new rater opens a juniper work-bond of 0.6 POA unlocking only after 18 graded seats with median ≥2, while a marble fingerprint hashes the first 4 final txs into a non-transferable cedar seal peers check before payout. Cost: 0.6 POA locked ~9 days plus ~40s seal compute; N clones pay N bonds. Verification: graders recompute the seal from on-chain parents and reject duplicates. Failure-handling: if the seal oracle stalls, pause payouts 24h and require two independent attestors before release.
